title: Caseum, hypoxia, and lesion-centric PK
dek: Cavitary caseum is necrotic, hypoxic, and poorly vascular. Cidal INH looks brilliant in log-phase broth and modest in caseum. Sterilizing drugs are the ones that still work there.
story: The granuloma is not a well-stirred beaker. Closed necrotic foci and open cavities fill with caseum: lipid-rich, low pH, hypoxic, and weakly perfused. Drug concentrations measured in plasma are a start; concentrations in caseum are the sterilizing question. Rifamycins and pyrazinamide earn their reputation here; INH’s early bactericidal activity is mostly the replicating rim.

DosR-adapted persisters in caseum are not genetically resistant. They are phenotypically tolerant. That is why monotherapy of cavitary disease manufactures katG mutants at the rim while the core waits for a sterilizing partner.

Bedaquiline and pretomanid were partly championed because caseum and hollow-fibre models liked them. That does not make them substitutes for knowing whether the cavity is still smear-positive at month two.
deepTitle: What a genomics lab cannot see
deep: WGS on sputum samples the airway-connected cavity more than the closed nodule. Heteroresistance in caseum can be invisible in a single expectorated genome.
PZA’s pH dependence is a caseum story. Neutral MGIT PZA DST is a different planet.
Moxifloxacin penetrates lesions well; that is one reason HPMZ could shorten DS-TB. gyrA mutants in the cavity still win if you guess.
PET/CT lesion-volume papers are research overlays, not WHO regimen gates.

visual.caption: From airway to necrotic core: oxygen, replication, and drug effect fall together. Sterilizing drugs are judged at the core, not in log-phase MIC plates.
visual.annotation: Plasma Cmax is not caseum Cmax.

example.title: Month-2 smear-positive, genome WT
example.setup: Cavitary DS-TB, HRZE, month-2 smear 2+, WGS still pan-susceptible.

steps.title: Tolerance is not katG
steps.body: Caseum persisters explain smear lag. Do not switch to MDR therapy from a smear alone.

steps.title: Look for holes in adherence and PK
steps.body: Missed doses, malabsorption, a leftover cavity.

steps.title: Culture still matters
steps.body: A rising TTP is reassuring; a new rpoB subpopulation is not.

example.takeaway: Caseum is why short-course needs sterilizing partners, not just cidal INH.

check.prompt: The sterilizing niche that most justifies rifamycin + PZA is:
check.why: Early cidal activity is the rim. Relapse prevention is the core.

Strong early cidal activity at the replicating rim, weak in caseum

check.why: That split is why INH monotherapy of cavities manufactures resistance.
